title: Draft record
description: The board's unsent work (AD-20), held apart from the log and never sent to the agent: the delivery mode, the question in view, and per question, by its item ID, the revision the work was made on, the values of its items by item ID as the view holds them, and, since widget-registry, the results of its widget items by item ID, since atoms the entries of its input atoms by item ID, since table-widget the entries of a Table's cells by item ID and cell, the "Other…" text, the option notes, the open prompt's text (note), the follow-up composer's text, and any act held for Submit (an answer, a decline, a postpone, a note alone, or the undo of a sent postpone or decline as reopen) with its order and whether "Select recommended" made it. Its keys are checked as IDs here, and as own properties naming the ask's questions where the board document is known (draftRecordProblems). A record longer than the contract's draft limit, as JSON, is refused.

values.description: The view's value of each item of the question, by item ID: any JSON, as the draft store holds it.

results.description: Since widget-registry: the result each widget item of the question holds, by item ID: any JSON, as the view's results store holds it, apart from the values.

entries.description: Since atoms: the text each input atom of the question holds that gives no value (unreadable, or outside its bounds), by item ID, 1 to 200 characters each. Unsent work like the values; an entry keeps the question from being answered until the user corrects or clears it, and is never part of an answer.

cellEntries.description: Since table-widget: the text each cell of a Table of the question holds that gives no value (unreadable, or outside its column's bounds), by item ID and then by cell, `row.field` (a row ID, a dot and a column's field), 1 to 200 characters each and at most 2,000 cells per item. Unsent work like the entries; a cell entry keeps the question from being answered until the user corrects or clears it, and is never part of an answer.

context.description: Where the user placed the question's context, since 1.2 (excerpts, design decision 6): beside the question or inline under it. It is a layout choice, never unsent work.
